newsitem.title: USA: Ag Services positioned for FY98 targets.
newsitem.headline: Ag Services positioned for FY98 targets.

text.p: Ag Services of America Inc said demands for its services coupled with a recently announced $135 million securitization program should keep growth and profit objectives on target for fiscal 1998.
A company spokesman said Ag Services wants to grow net revenues and earnings 20 to 25 percent.

Earlier Monday, the company, which supplies farm seed, fertilizer, agricultural chemicals and crop insurance, reported diluted per-share earnings of $0.84, up from $0.72, for the February 28 fiscal year. Revenues gained to $147.6 million from $114.7 million.
